name: Immiscible noise (assign noise to the latent it is closest to)
plain: Draws a batch of candidate noises and keeps, for each slice of the latent (by channel by default), the candidate nearest a reference such as the positive prediction. The idea comes from a 2024 paper on training; the README notes it was made for training, not sampling.
math:
Symbols: n_i candidates; r reference slice.
dist_ij = mean((r_i − n_j)²); assignment minimises total distance (maximize flips it).
Output keeps the latent's shape.
